units: proportion (rates in [0,1], differences in [-1,1]); *_pp fields are display values in percentage points

code_ticket.note: G3 with the C4 verdict replaced by CONTRADICTED wherever the code-computed ticket scope says an approved ticket applies. Exploratory; not used for H1, H1-C4 or H2.

h2_adjudication_sensitivity_exploratory.what: H2 with every run-adjudicated escalation counted as qualifying (calls unchanged)

verifier_eval.note: Diagnostic accuracy is over every package; gate-path numbers only over packages that reached C4. Rates are proportions.

retrieval.note: Technique tags are proxy relevance labels: technique-level retrieval, not event-level relevance. Proportions.

taxonomy.note: The six tags are applied by people on the Traces page (none are applied yet). 'suggested' counts are the three tags the code derives from trace and labels (scoring/taxonomy.py). The ten example traces are chosen by the fixed rule in scripts/final_results.py, not starred or tagged by a person.
